topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I can't quite believe I'm back here, standing on the sidewalk, watching the tow truck drive away with my car. It’s a mess, really. I was so sure it was fine, parked in the driveway like I always do. Didn’t even consider that maybe, just maybe, some city ordinance or a neighbor’s complaint had me in their crosshairs. Now, as I stand here, all I can think about is the chaos this will bring—getting to the impound, dealing with the fines, trying to explain all of this to people who need a ride or are expecting me elsewhere. I keep telling myself it’s just a day, a series of unfortunate events, but the weight of it all feels a lot heavier than that.
